sentence: Ich freue mich auf die Reise.
translation_en: I am looking forward to the trip.

sentence: Wir interessieren uns für moderne Kunst.
translation_en: We are interested in modern art.

sentence: Er ärgert sich über den verschobenen Termin.
translation_en: He is annoyed about the postponed appointment.

sentence: In zwei Wochen beginnt das Filmfestival.
tip: in plus time can refer to the future.
translation_en: The film festival begins in two weeks.

sentence: Während des Films war mein Handy aus.
tip: während can introduce a time span.
translation_en: During the film my phone was off.

tip: warten auf is a prepositional verb.
translation_en: I am waiting for your explanation.

tip: egal sein uses dative for the person.
translation_en: This trend does not matter to me.

sentence: Wir müssen den Termin leider verschieben.
translation_en: Unfortunately we have to postpone the appointment.

sentence: Ich vermute, dass sie gute Freunde sind.
tip: dass sends the verb to the end.
translation_en: I assume that they are good friends.

sentence: In dieser Stadt wünsche ich mir mehr Parks.
translation_en: In this city I wish for more parks.

sentence: Mein Lieblingsfilm läuft am Freitag im Kino.
tip: laufen can mean to be showing.
translation_en: My favorite film is playing at the cinema on Friday.

sentence: Bitte füllen Sie den Fragebogen aus.
